metadata.description: Agent007 - Intelligent Development Orchestration for Claude Code

plugins.name: agent007
plugins.description: 13 expert agents, 57 skills, 43 deterministic hooks — SDD pipeline with 4 auto-gates (checklist/debate/analyze/diff-verify), V7.3 auto-loop (fail→feedback→retry→converge), parallel fan-out with worktree isolation, behavioral contracts as identity (DECLARE_BEFORE_ACT/SCOPE_IS_CONTRACT/SIMPLEST_SOLUTION/VERIFY_NOT_ASSUME), file-based state (openspec+.sdlc), first-run onboarding, tool allowlist with pipe data-flow detection. Python 3.9+ compatible. Cross-platform (macOS/Linux/Windows).
